role_definitions.biological_mechanism: Evidence of operation in an identified organism; observation/model limits remain explicit.
role_definitions.comparative_anatomy: Observed structure, attachment or comparative mechanical analogy; no assumed taxonomic/functional equivalence.
role_definitions.artistic_interpretation: Proposed form, material, composition or interpretive lesson from artwork, objects or arrangement.
role_definitions.optical_technique: Imaging or localized optical-change reference; distinguishes illumination, labeling, pigment and emission.

reference_only_rules.rule: Use reference URLs for form, proportion, part layout, motion and palette only; no tracing, projection, photobashing, baking, displacement/normal extraction or shipped source-image bytes.
No dossier image goes to an image generator as an input or style image.
COPYRIGHT_REFERENCE_ONLY material is viewed in its own page, never saved into repository or review sheets.
Any later permissible review reproduction must follow applicable attribution/use conditions. This companion establishes no rights and reproduces no images.
Describe AI substance plates verbally and avoid naming living artists or studios. Recorded as a recommendation, not a new ruling.
No remote assets, image bytes, downloads, production edits, generation or runtime scripts are part of this artifact.
The user's removal of conspicuous stripes remains in force. Dossier bands/grids do not require restoring them or making species identical.
Preserve behavior owners and species laws. Source motion or era does not authorize a new receptor, gameplay action or waking-world prop.
Generic anatomy or art analogies do not close species-specific mechanism gaps; retain complementary primary papers.

verification_statement.metadata_method: Copy numbered source-table metadata from the supplied Git object and validate local JSON cross-references.
verification_statement.source_text_limit: Ellipses in dossier titles, attributions and cautions are preserved rather than silently completed.

shared_integration_cautions: Dossier 44 explicitly lacks stalk contraction; 45 does not establish daughter inversion.
Dossier 27 sensory stereocilia are not a motile-cilia movement reference.
Dossier 19, 21, 27, 28, 55, 59 and 68 include labeling/coloring/illumination effects; 36 includes illumination-dependent diffraction. These do not establish natural pigment or intrinsic emission.
Dossier 62 and 72 concern human-arranged diatoms, not living Bacillaria cohesion.
Dossier 92, 94 and 100 disclose incomplete visual verification; 95, 99 and 100 link secondary pages. None is newly certified here.
Dossier 100 equates fictional hydraulic muscles and muscular hydrostats too strongly; retain speculative body logic rather than universal 'swell then extend' mechanics.
Dossier 63 has inconsistent review-copy wording versus its reference-only category. Retain URL-only use until resolved; it is not adopted for these specimens.
R/G affects optical appearance, not a new Noctiluca flash trigger.
Neutral grey renders are diagnostic, not final art direction. Maintain species distinction within the project's wine, flesh, mineral and jewel vocabulary.
